comment: Renderer-neutral look values neither the lighting bible (lighting-bible.json) nor the rain pack (rain-bible.json) fixes, tuned for the owner's phone checks. Both renderers read them from here; nothing look-related is hard-coded in shaders or Swift (owner, 6 Oct). Change log: docs/look-spec-changes.md.

wetPaving.comment: Departure from rain-v1 (owner's phone check, 7 Oct): the pack's paving darkening x3.8, so steady rain darkens concrete ~38% and asphalt ~42%, light rain ~30%.

houseContrast.comment: Generator (P2), house-details families: house-contrast-v1 per house type (R approved, binding), values identical to Resources/look/mock-values.json (keys in mockKeys; a unit test fails on drift): trim, roof and daytime window glass colours; soffit and porch-underside colours on down-facing faces; the eave/cornice shadow band fading to eave_shadow.relativeBrightness (wall = 1) at the eave line or parapet top. Walls stay observed/profile colours. Families map to the pack's four types by type and wall material (P2 mapping, docs/buildings/README.md); brickStackedFacade picks two- or three-flat by storeys. eaveBandHeight is the existing near wall band (geometry), not a pack value.
